name: Celestial Stag

actions.name: Antler Charge
actions.effect: The stag charges up to 12m and gores a target. Target must pass PHYS save or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Purifying Presence
actions.effect: All allies within 6m are cured of one poison, disease, or curse effect. Additionally, they heal 2d6 HP.

reactions.name: Guardian's Sacrifice
reactions.effect: When an ally within 6m takes damage, the Celestial Stag can take half the damage instead.

traits.name: Aura of Purity
traits.desc: All allies within 6m have +1d6 to saves against poison and disease.

traits.name: Forest Guardian
traits.desc: Plants in a 30m radius around the stag grow faster and healthier. Corrupted or blighted land is slowly purified by its presence.

lore: Celestial Stags are divine guardians of sacred forests and natural places. Their mere presence purifies corruption and disease. They appear to those in dire need, guiding lost travelers to safety and healing the wounded.
